answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 14 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 860 identities costs 860 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The voyage is the check that cannot be faked, the prism is the price the attacker pays, and the basalt is the record that outlives the epoch.
